assumptions.note: OCP HBF v0.7.0 leaves NAND timing, erase-block geometry, core-die bandwidth, and endurance limits product specific. Values below are modelling assumptions; see docs/research/params.md.
assumptions.pages_per_block: assumption: 256 pages/block (OCP v0.7.0 section 11.5.1.8 hints 256/512/1024; SPLASH/FlashAccel use 192; docs/research/params.md)
assumptions.blocks_per_plane: assumption: 512 blocks/plane (512 GiB physical capacity per stack; docs/research/params.md)
assumptions.aggregate_gb_s: assumption: 1024 GB/s core-die aggregate (SPLASH; OCP v0.7.0 Table 4 host link grades are 384/1536/3072 GB/s; docs/research/params.md)
assumptions.op_ratio: assumption: 0.07 (MQSim SSD overprovisioning; OCP HBF has no host-visible OP or GC)
assumptions.pe_limits: assumption: 1e4-1e6 P/E cycles swept in lifetime models (product specific; docs/research/params.md)
